notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.21.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Family "Khung nha xe - 02" (Cot 2 canh, 1 mai): chon family nao thi mai, xa go, mang, up noc tu sinh bam he khung do (01 = mai buom; 02 = 1 mai / 2 mai gap nhau tai noc / rang cua Ngang nha); bien the family theo cao do MAI + doc cho ca 2 family. - 3 quy tac cao do: xa go gac tren canh keo (mai tren xa go), level MAI = diem thap nhat cua mai, DINH MAI = diem cao nhat cua mai. - Truc bien dat ten A-Z va 1-99; mep cot tu dong bang mep truc bien (cot bien lui nua de 250, o "de cot" de doi). - Mac dinh moi: Doc nha, A. 1 hang cot giua, mep nen 0 (nen = ranh), console dau hoi 100.
